sham.mechanism: natural pinch of the device-0 rod at ~23 tu; drift of the device-1 vortex

feed_neck.mechanism: division: feeding the neck suppresses the pinch

starve_neck.mechanism: division/decay: starving the neck pinches it at ~8 tu

starve_vortex.mechanism: weak vorticity decays without fuel: vortex dies by ~25 tu

stir_cut.mechanism: signed stir: partial cancellation, the remnant regrows by eating

follow_vortex.mechanism: mutual advection: device 1 tracks its drifting vortex

feed_and_follow.mechanism: growth and motion together: a fed vortex tracked while it drifts

known_limits: One prepared state and one apparatus; not a held-out generalization benchmark.
Two grading truths per case; score scales are calibration-ensemble standard deviations.
Native and ablated controls are privileged diagnostics, not learned agents.
